review_description: Yes it was a good system yet too early to make any further comments
All good. So far, so good, as long as the sun keeps shining.
Prompt service - did everything to get the installation right. Great people to deal with.

I subsequently learned that I was eligible for a 3 kilowatt system from the nsw govt to which I have upgraded to a 6.6 kilowatt system. I was not impressed with positive energy but very impressed with SolarEze.

Very friendly efficient installation, good value for money, very happy with the product, only thing we would have liked is a better monitoring system, the one we have only shows generation not how much we're using or whats going to the grid, so will have to look at upgrading that.

The installation went very well. They came out, removed the old system & installed the new rails, wiring & inverter.I then had the roof repainted. They returned 3 weeks later, as agreed, & completed the installation.Customer service was excellent.  They even arranged for an updated smart meter to be installed.
Positive Energy arranged everything.  Just waiting on the smart meter to be installed and then all good.  Peter was very helpful.

3 quotes the 2nd quote of Positive Energy was outstanding.Peter who came and spoke with us to give direction on what would best suit our home.Debbie who took pictures of our roof from NetMap and organised to quote.Sons Jonnie-Justin and Daughter Jessica plus employee Nathan whom all installed the Solar System.Everything was well informed and efficient and the 4 individuals worked so well together it was a sheer pleasure to have them turn up and work tirelessly then when completed left as if they were not there at all! This Solar Company is AAA+
The process was very easy and straightforward.  Good customer service.
Polite, tidy and punctualProvided additional ideas and solutions to some problems which other suppliers did not respond toPrice was mid range

Positive Energy arrived on time to give me a quote and was very knowledgeable on his products and explained/answered all of my questionsInstallation was done on time. Lovely young brother and sister crew installed the solar. No mess left behindAll of the connection to my energy company was organised for me. Received a pack in the mail with receipt and warranty etc.Highly recommend this family business

The team at Positive Energy were great and very helpful with what I found to be a complex decision.Also nice to provide business to locals, and great that they are not far from where I live in case they need to pop back.Answered all my queries and great to see a whole family from the installation to the admin completing the job.Thanks Positive Energy.I'll definitely refer you to other family and friends that are upgrading there Solar systems.5 out of 5

They Should organize with energy supplies for customers to use system ASAP after installation ,I am still waiting on origin to replace meter 1 month since installed and they didn’t tell me that I can review or check use with mobile phone app so I don’t know how how its working.
The team from Positive Energy where honest & reliable. The installation team were quick and efficient. We were really happy with the whole process & would highly recommend Positive Energy.
Great crew, supplied all information regarding solar installation and components, installed within a week, cleaned site before leaving

Very friendly service and straight forward in explaining my options. Installed within 2 weeks of the quote. I’ve only had the system for a few weeks and I called him up with some questions and he came around and explained things and showed me on my inverter at no extra cost. So far so good!
Yea happy with the service and very family friendly and professional service

I was impressed by the customer service and product knowledge of all 3 competitors nominated by solar quotes. I ultimately accepted the cheapest quote on recommended budget range equipment.The installation was smooth and timely and with high degree of  workmanship.Everything was delivered as promised and without any prompting.
Good servicePunctual and politePete organised everything with energy provider
Good honest family company , punctual installation , and actually got on the roof to make sure they could fit 20 panels for a full 6.6 kw , when other companies said that only 19 would fit
Fast, efficient and very cost effective solar solution and installation. Very knowledgeable, quick to respond and good communication. Highly recommended.
We are very impressed with the service we have received so far from Positive Energy.  They provided their quote quickly and installed the system promptly and efficiently.
Fast to quote, fast to install, very nice people and organized everything.
The people at Positive Energy were very easy to deal with and did the work efficiently and professionally, nothing was too much trouble.

Still waiting on our energy company (Origin) to change our meter so that the solar provider can change the timings for the hot water and give us access, via app, to the inverter readings so that we can monitor what’s being produced. It’s looking good so far. Whatever happens the information and advice on your website was invaluable.We contacted your finance recommendation - Parker Lane but they would only offer a loan at a higher rate of interest over 10 years (my husband is full time permanent but i’m In temporary work - with same company for last 8 months).

All was good and quick .still waiting for connections to grid, B4 I can comment on satisfaction from the system and any follow up if required.Never got the other quote, made appointment they rang twice to let me know they are running late!!Third call they told me it was too late and they will call back to make a new appointment.They never called back!!!
Everything was quite easy to arrange.Only problem is I’m still waiting for AGL to upgrade to a suitable smart meter to be able to make use of my solar installation. 5 weeks and still waiting.
So far so good but our energy provider is still to install meter box so unsure about savings! The sungrow app hasn’t worked for a week.

Dealing with Positive Energy was really easy. They took the time to go over my solar needs and came up with a great value/quality component package that was installed in a few hours. Still waiting for AGL to upgrade my meter, which should be any day now. Looking forward to flicking the switch and saving!Thanks solar quotes for getting me started.

We signed the contract last Tuesday and they are installing this coming week, 7 - 10 day turn around, others were quoting 4 - 6 weeks and a deposit. No payment until instalment, Fantastic. Positive Energy gave us a great deal on the equipment we requested (Fronius), much better price than larger companies. They have visited us twice and no pressure came to bear, unlike one of the other companies recommended. They were so good I recommended them to two other families in the area who are also taking up their offers from Positive Energy. Now I have to talk to family members.
Positive energy were courteous and efficient and installed the system at a competitive price.

Positive Energy Staff were professional, courteous, on-time and are always there to assist you. Fantastic prices and quality service and installation. we wouldn't go anywhere else for our solar installation! Great to see a company that takes pride in its work, products, service and staff!
I highly recommend Peter and Debbie they give great advice and professional installation
Very helpful, describe the process and turned up when he said he would

The above comprises several solar systems, installed and paid for over a number of years, with the (combined) price(s) reflecting this fact.All installations were well handled, and a good job all round.All have been (and are currently) running well.
Family business. Very friendly, knowledgable and happy to help.
Peter and his family buiseness was excellent to deal with and offer the best and prompt follow-up support. I could not be happier with the results of their work, cheerfulness and overall dealings.
They are very professional kept us informed all through the process would and have recommended to freinds that also purchased systems from them after looking at my system
